landing.title: ikimon — Enjoy Life through nearby nature
landing.heroHeadingPlain: Your usual walk becomes an adventure.
landing.heroLead: Walk, find something, and save it with a place. When names and differences become a little clearer, you want to walk again.
heroPromiseChips: Nearby nature gets a little more interesting
One travel photo becomes a reason to return

dailyDashboard.title: Choose a reason to go outside
dailyDashboard.lead: Record, revisit, or look nearby. The first screen stays focused on enjoying nature today.
dailyDashboard.seasonalEmpty: Seasonal clues are still being collected

recordToday.title: Save today's find
recordToday.body: Save what you found with a photo and a short note.

revisitPlace.title: Go back to a place you walked
revisitPlace.body: The same place changes when the season moves.

nearbyPulse.title: See where nearby records are moving
nearbyPulse.body: Use active areas as a reason for the next walk.

needsId.title: Open a record that needs a name
needsId.body: Turn an uncertain record into the next discovery.

landing.toolSectionTitle: Save field clues. Choose from the map.
landing.toolSectionLead: Save the photo, sound, place, and note before you need the final name, or choose where to walk next. Both paths lead back to a record you can revisit.

lens.title: Keep what caught your eye for later
lens.body: Point the camera and AI returns candidates and clues. It helps you keep the photo, sound, place, and note without pretending to be the final answer.

scan.title: Choose today's walk from the map
scan.body: Use nearby finds, seasonal changes, and gaps to choose the next place worth walking.

landing.mapSectionTitle: Find places that make you want to walk again
landing.mapSectionLead: Nearby paths and travel stops both hold reasons for the next walk. See what has been found and decide one next step.
landing.mapEmpty: No observations on the map yet

fieldLoop.title: Find. Learn. Save. Help someone else.
fieldLoop.lead: Find something, check a few clues, and save it with the place. The more people keep these small records, the easier nearby nature becomes to understand.

steps.title: 1. Find
steps.body: Notice something on a walk or while traveling.

steps.title: 2. Learn
steps.body: Use AI clues and your own eyes to look a little closer.

steps.title: 3. Save
steps.body: Keep the photo, place, time, and a short note together.

steps.title: 4. Help
steps.body: Small records can become clues for local nature, research, and conservation.

principles: Keep records even before you know the name.
Turn each record into the next walk.

community.title: Community | ikimon
community.heading: Join walks and themed surveys
community.lead: Start with a solo walk, then sometimes look at the same place with others. Community events, themed surveys, and small local programs live here.

learnIndex.title: Reading index | ikimon.life
learnIndex.heading: Reading index
learnIndex.lead: One topic per page: how to start observing, check names, and keep records useful later.

map.title: Life map | ikimon.life
map.footerNote: Zoom in to see where records, species, parks, and water-side clues are gathering.

lens.title: Save clues | ikimon.life
lens.footerNote: AI returns candidates and hints. People decide what the record means.

hero.heading: Save what caught your eye for later
hero.lead: On a walk or while traveling, point the camera at a scene and AI returns candidates plus hints. You do not have to decide the name here. This is the entry for saving photo, sound, place, and note clues first.

steps.title: 1. Save first
steps.body: It can stay uncertain. Keep the photo, place, time, and first impression before they disappear.

steps.title: 2. Look for what to keep, not only the name
steps.body: The point is not to accept a candidate name. It is to see which clues will help you revisit the record later.

steps.title: 3. Move the clues into a record
steps.body: This page does not save the record by itself. Use the record screen to keep the photo, place, and note together.

guidanceCards.title: When you do not want to lose the clues from this place
guidanceCards.body: Use it when saving first and comparing later matters more than answering on the spot.

guidanceCards.title: Save the photo and place as a record
guidanceCards.body: This page is only a clue helper. Keep the place, time, and photo on the record screen.

followupCards.title: Saved clues become records
followupCards.body: What you noticed on a walk becomes useful when the photo, place, and note stay together.
followupCards.meta: The clue helper and the record library have separate roles.

followupCards.title: Open the map first
followupCards.body: If you want to decide where to go before checking a name, the map is the faster entry.
followupCards.meta: This page saves clues; the map chooses the next place.

followupCards.title: Use live guide for continuous records
followupCards.body: Use this page for one scene at a time. Use live guide when you want to keep video or sound while walking.
followupCards.meta: One scene here, continuous records in live guide.
